notes: SPMI/RFFE do not define OTP as a protocol concept. Identity and capability are exposed through the SPMI Device Descriptor Block and RFFE ID registers, and device identifiers (SLAVE_ID/MASTER_ID/USID/GSID) are assigned or strapped. An implementation may back these with fuses, but the spec only requires they be discoverable over the bus.
